notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to put an activated and/or a triggered ability onto the stack.
You have not cast an instant spell this turn.
description:
Put any triggered and/or activated ability onto the stack.
Holding priority, cast Vantress Visions by paying {1}{U}, targeting the activated or triggered ability.
Alania and Veyran trigger twice.
Resolve both Veyran triggers, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Resolve the first Alania trigger, choosing to have an opponent draw a card and copying Vantress Visions, with the copy targeting Alania's remaining trigger.
Veyran triggers twice, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Resolve the copy of Vantress Visions, copying Alania's trigger.
Repeat from step 5.
